brief:
Palestinians commemorated the 109th anniversary of the Balfour Declaration on Wednesday, marking what they view as a foundational act of colonial injustice that paved the way for the establishment of Israel, the Ma'an news agency reported. The 1917 British declaration promised a Jewish homeland in Palestine, a commitment Palestinians say violated their rights and displaced their communities.

The commemoration reflects Palestinian rejection of the declaration's legacy and its role in shaping decades of conflict in the region.
title: Palestinians mark 109th anniversary of Balfour Declaration
